subject: general
question:
Choose the alternative set whose numbers are related in the same way as the numbers in the set given below.

(Note: The entire operation has to be performed on the whole number itself, without dividing the numbers into their components. For example, in the case of 13, all the operations have to be performed on 13 itself. That is, addition/subtraction/multiplication etc. have to be done with 13 but 13 has to be divided into its components 1 and 0 and then no mathematical operations can be performed on 1 and 0.)

(384, 32, 6)

(408, 68, 3)
solution:
The logic follows here is,

**( Middle number × Last number ) × 2 = First number**

(384, 32, 6) →

(32 × 6) × 2 = 192 × 2 = 384<
